name: Transcribe research interviews with speaker roles and timestamps
tagline: Interview transcripts that label the interviewer and the interviewee, with timestamps, verbatim or clean.
description: Floatboat Interview Transcription turns research interviews, user research sessions, focus groups, oral histories, podcasts and job interviews into transcripts where every line is labelled by role - interviewer or participant - with a timestamp. Choose verbatim (every um and false start) or clean verbatim, and get a summary of the themes with supporting quotes. It accepts MP3, M4A, WAV, WebM, MP4 or MOV files up to 500 MB and 3 hours, and exports to Word, SRT or CSV. Pricing is by the minute (4 hours $5, 10 hours $10), failed jobs are refunded, and recordings are deleted within 7 days and never used to train AI.
